name: Iglucraft Single Iglusauna 4-Person Fully Assembled Outdoor Sauna
description: Single Iglusauna Fully Assembled, Outdoor Sauna, 4-person Iglucraft has created the perfect backyard escape designed to allow you to take time for personal wellness, introspection, and relaxation. Hand-crafted by true artisans in Nordic Estonia and shipped fully assembled to you, the Iglusauna Single creates a charming home sauna sanctuary with a timeless and upscale appearance. With comfortable accommodation for up to 4 persons, your family and friends will enjoy years of well-being and relaxation. Iglucraft shares your love for saunas, and they have produced a premium-quality sauna perfectly configured for bather comfort. The silky-smooth aspen benches provide exceptional comfort, and the natural arcing shape allows the heat and steam to circulate naturally. The exterior and interior are nothing short of a work of art. A wooden door with a glass window provides natural light and easy access. The black wooden floor provides a dramatic contrast with the light aspen benches, backrests, and footrests. This robustly constructed sauna arrives fully assembled at your home. Prewired dotless LED lighting elegantly illuminates the interior and accentuates the beauty of the hand-selected wood. Brightness adjustment allows you to create an atmosphere that reflects your mood. The Iglucraft Single sauna offers two distinct heating options. For a rustic, traditional experience, it includes a wood-fired sauna stove and chimney. Alternatively, for modern convenience, the unit can be equipped with an electric sauna heater and features an electrical compartment for easy installation (electric sauna heater sold separately). Enjoy a one-of-a-kind sauna from master-craftsmen with timeless charm and unparalleled comfort—the Iglucraft Single home sauna hut. NOTE: Unit is sold and shipped fully assembled. Features Fully assembled Iglusauna Up to 4 bathers Ergonomic, round structure that supports optimal airflow and natural ventilation Triple-layered spruce shingles Natural aspen interior Beautiful aspen benches, backrests, and footrests that ensure maximum comfortability Natural wooden door with a glass window A Black wooden floor that provides a unique contrast Ample interior lighting Locking exterior door Exterior electric box Pre-installed door sensor Handmade in Estonia Includes Unit is sold and shipped fully assembled Specifications SINGLE Model SINGLE / SINGLE W Exterior Materials Spruce Interior Materials Aspen Bench, Backrest, Footrest Material Aspen Exterior Length 94.50" (240.03 cm) Exterior Width 94.50" (240.03 cm) Exterior Height 100" (254 cm) Weight 1,980 lbs (898 kg) Useable Floor Area 42 sq.ft (3.9 sq.m) Assembly & Maintenance Iglucraft Iglusauna Specification Warranty For more information regarding the warranty and returns for this product, please consult the manual below or contact customer service. It is securely packaged on a wooden pallet within a protective wooden frame. NOTE: Offloading and onsite handling require specialized equipment such as a forklift or crane. The delivery driver’s responsibility is limited to drop-off, offering minimal assistance. Before shipping, we proactively connect with customers to communicate shipment details and address any special delivery conditions that might impact logistics or incur extra costs. As soon as we receive your order, we automatically reach out to our suppliers to confirm that it is in stock and available for immediate shipment. We will send you tracking information within 24 hours of your order leaving the warehouse to the e-mail address you provided when checking out. If you do not receive tracking information from us within six business days of your order, feel free to follow up with us at customercare@nordicasauna.com . No shipping outside the lower 48 States in the USA. What if my shipment is damaged? Please inspect the packaging of your item(s) when they arrive. If you notice any damage, you should make a note of it when signing for delivery. If your item(s) do arrive damaged please send photos to customercare@nordicasauna.com and we will process an insurance claim on your behalf. Cancellations (Before order ships) Nordica Sauna prides itself on having one of the best return policies in the industry. Your warranty will guarantee you a fully functional and operational product. If it is unclear whether your order is custom or made to order, please message or call us.
